en.name: Brow Lift (Forehead Lift)
en.meta_title: Brow Lift (Forehead Lift): Correcting a Sagging Brow & Forehead Lines
en.meta_description: Revitalize your upper face with a brow lift (forehead lift). This procedure raises a heavy, sagging brow and smooths deep forehead lines for a more refreshed, alert, and youthful appearance. Learn about our minimally invasive techniques.
en.meta_keywords: brow lift, forehead lift, endoscopic brow lift, sagging brow, forehead wrinkles, frown lines, upper face rejuvenation, cosmetic surgery

what_is.heading: What is a Brow Lift? A Refreshed Upper Face
paragraphs: A brow lift, also known as a forehead lift, is a surgical procedure that revitalizes the upper face by correcting a heavy, sagging brow and reducing deep horizontal forehead lines. As we age, the brow can descend, creating a tired, angry, or sad appearance and contributing to hooding of the upper eyelids. A brow lift raises the eyebrows to a more alert and youthful position.

procedure.heading: Minimally Invasive Endoscopic Technique
paragraphs: At LUNAI, we utilize modern, minimally invasive endoscopic techniques for the brow lift whenever possible. This involves small incisions hidden within the hairline, through which we can lift and reposition the forehead tissues. This approach minimizes scarring and shortens recovery time compared to traditional methods. The result is a smoother forehead and a more open, refreshed eye area.

candidates_recovery.heading: Candidates and Long-Lasting Results
paragraphs: A brow lift is an excellent option for individuals with low or sagging brows, deep forehead furrows, or frown lines between the eyebrows. It is often performed in conjunction with a facelift or eyelid surgery for a more complete rejuvenation. Downtime is typically about one week. A brow lift provides long-lasting results, helping you look naturally refreshed and more approachable for many years.
